svg.title: How build runs each lane: lanes in parallel, tests with teeth
svg.desc: The plan groups tasks into lanes that own disjoint files. Your session, the orchestrator, starts one Sonnet builder per logic lane in the background and runs the inline lanes itself. In every lane each task goes red (a test failing on an assertion about the result), green, then a commit scoped to the lane's files. A builder lane ends with a mutation (one line broken on purpose: the pinned test must fail on an assertion, then the line is restored) and four checks by the orchestrator: nothing uncommitted, a commit per task, no skipped or weakened tests, the lane's tests rerun green. When all lanes finish, the full suite runs once; a red result goes back to the lane that owns the file and resumes the same builder, up to two rounds; green goes on to review.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: LANES IN PARALLEL. TESTS WITH TEETH.
each lane: a test that fails on the result first. Builder lanes end with a mutation and 4 checks

svg.text: red → back to the lane that owns the file: the same builder resumes, max 2 rounds
mutation: break one line a pinned test covers. It must fail on an assertion, then the line comes back
4 checks before lane done: nothing uncommitted · a commit per task · no skipped or weakened tests · lane tests rerun green
--reviewed: one task-reviewer per lane reads its diff once, Spec + Quality
stuck after three fixes: one retry on Opus, then you decide

g.text: NO TASK DONE WITHOUT ITS TEST · NO BUILD DONE WITHOUT THE FULL SUITE GREEN
